result_summary: Three disjoint normalized original-coordinate scalar banks with effective symmetric 3x3 matrix K satisfying sigma_min(K)>=s have an essentially bounded quadratic-form density <296/s, uniformly in arbitrary affine terms from conditioned outside coordinates. The proof transfers the LPP sqrt(2) one-dimensional marginal cap, rescales to independent cap-one bank variables, and uses a deterministic alpha=9/16 dichotomy between a quantitative scalar pivot and a quantitative indefinite physical pair. Exact zero-pivot subcase is sharpened using the completed account04/B18 theorem to 12|det K|^(-1/3), with continuity.

primary_source.citation: Livshyts--Paouris--Pivovarov, On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures, Israel J. Math. 216 (2016), arXiv:1507.07949
primary_source.used_hypothesis: product of one-dimensional probability densities each bounded by one
primary_source.used_conclusion: every k-dimensional orthogonal marginal density <=2^(k/2); in particular each normalized scalar bank <=sqrt(2)

internal_dependencies.use: rank-three nonzero scalar-pivot bound with arbitrary affine term
designated partner exact zero-pivot inequality and continuity

partner_actual_inequality: ||p_Q||_infinity <=12 |det K|^(-1/3) for a zero pivot in the three-bank theorem; <=12 under sigma_min(K)>=1
remaining_implication: Bare s_3(A)>=1 still does not force a uniformly nonsingular three-disjoint-scalar-bank representation. The live small-pivot star / plane-plus-one and arbitrary-extra-spectrum compiler remains unpaid; the new theorem is an endpoint once such a grouped certificate is produced.
